projects.title: Outpost – Self-hosted chess coach
description: Built two LangGraph agents: a day-review pipeline, and a coach that routes each question by intent and streams answers token by token over SSE using LangGraph's custom stream writer.
The engine and the graph supply every fact (eval swings, rating changes, recurring motifs); the LLM (Claude or Ollama) only writes the wording, so it cannot make up analysis.
Designed a Neo4j schema that keys every position by FEN, so the coach can find the same mistake across games and generate puzzles from it.
Wrote the browser's UCI client so a single Stockfish worker serves every view, which is what lets the whole game review run with the backend switched off.

projects.title: CoWordle – Real-time Multiplayer Wordle
description: Real-time multiplayer Wordle where players in a room race on the same word over Socket.IO.
The server validates guesses and holds the answer so clients can't cheat, and reconnects restore in-progress games.
MongoDB stores rooms, rounds, and scores.

projects.title: Sudoku – Solver / Generator
description: Benchmarked backtracking against Knuth's Dancing Links (Algorithm X over a 324-constraint exact-cover matrix). On a puzzle built to break backtracking, DLX visits 81 nodes vs 69 million (0.03ms vs 1.9s).
The generator seeds the diagonal boxes and uses DLX to guarantee every puzzle has a unique solution.

projects.title: Timetable Generation System (UCTP)
description: Built a Genetic Algorithm solver for the University Course Timetabling Problem (UCTP), modeling room, instructor, and student-group clashes as hard constraints and preferences and gaps as soft.
Tuned a penalty-based fitness function to converge on conflict-free schedules.
